const greet = () => "hello";
const hello: "hello" = greet();

function twice(flag: boolean) {
  if (flag) return "same";
  return "same";
}
const same: "same" = twice(true);

const yes = () => true;
const truth: true = yes();

const numberOrA: () => "a" | number = () => "a";
const onlyA: "a" = numberOrA();

const wrongKind: () => "a" | 2 = () => 3;

function choose(flag: boolean) {
  if (flag) return "left";
  return "right";
}
let side = choose(true);
side = "up";
const fixed: "left" | "right" = choose(false);
console.log(hello, same, truth, onlyA, wrongKind, side, fixed);
